title: process: duplicate stale-status fix for PRM-02/03/04/05 — ADHOC-prm-reqctl-status-20260816 abort BLOCKER (fixed independently by WF02-prm02-05-20260816 / PR #795)
scope: Duplicate-work detection + process gap. ADHOC-prm-reqctl-status-20260816 was dispatched to mark PRM-02/03/04/05 RELEASED in docs/requirements.yaml after WF02-prm-batch2-20260814 (PR #784, commit b499ef9b) had been observed to update only the rendered snapshot. Pre-flight on HEAD ae9854f4 found PRM-02/03/04/05 already status: RELEASED — the fix was independently delivered by WF02-prm02-05-20260816 (PR #795). The ADHOC aborted BLOCKER with no code/docs change; the resulting housekeeping branch and stash were orphaned. Also carries the bookkeeping defect that GH-797's body originally read 'Tracked as ISS-0709' (ISS-0709 is the unrelated lint_handoffs/GH-796 issue) instead of pointing at a dedicated ISS.
description: GH-797 records duplicate-work detection for the PRM-02/03/04/05 RELEASED status. ADHOC-prm-reqctl-status-20260816 was dispatched to mark PRM-02/03/04/05 RELEASED in docs/requirements.yaml after WF02-prm-batch2-20260814 (PR #784, commit b499ef9b) had been observed to update only the rendered snapshot. Pre-flight on this ADHOC found PRM-02/03/04/05 already status: RELEASED at HEAD ae9854f4 — the fix was independently delivered by WF02-prm02-05-20260816 (PR #795 squash-merged at 2e9d3c99 on 2026-08-15; bookkeeping commit ae9854f4 on 2026-08-15T23:45:54Z). Both docs/requirements.yaml (canonical) and docs/status/requirement_status.yaml (snapshot) carry the RELEASED status with released_at in the 2026-08-15T23:28:26Z..23:28:29Z window. The pre-flight precondition triggered the BLOCKER ('if already RELEASED, STOP and FAIL with BLOCKER (someone else fixed it)'); no code/docs change was performed. Housekeeping branch housekeeping/reqctl-status-stale-20260816 sits at base_commit_sha == origin/main HEAD with no work to absorb; ORCH to delete it and drop the orphaned stash@{0} (ADHOC-prm-reqctl-status-20260816-pre-setup-stash). This ISS is the dedicated local record for GH-797; the GH-797 body reference to ISS-0709 was incorrect and was corrected to ISS-0710 by this Step 0.5. Do NOT implement the fix in Step 0.5 — Step 3 decides and implements the process-gap disposition.
symptom: A duplicate ADHOC (ADHOC-prm-reqctl-status-20260816) was dispatched to mark PRM-02/03/04/05 RELEASED against a stale repo view; its pre-flight discovered the target status already RELEASED at HEAD and aborted BLOCKER. The ADHOC produced no change but left an orphaned housekeeping branch and stash. Separately, GH-797's body stated 'Tracked as ISS-0709', which pointed at the unrelated lint_handoffs/GH-796 issue instead of a dedicated ISS for GH-797.
discovered_by: ORCH (WF03-GH797-20260816 dispatch; pre-flagged from ADHOC-prm-reqctl-status-20260816 abort BLOCKER)
root_cause: Dispatch-time staleness: an ADHOC was authorized against an outdated view of the repo; its pre-flight precondition caught the already-done state only after step-00 had already created the housekeeping branch and stash. No lightweight dispatch-time check (reqctl.py show <id> or git show HEAD:<file>) existed to short-circuit before work-branch creation. Bookkeeping: GH-797 was created with a 'Tracked as ISS-0709' line that referenced the wrong issue (ISS-0709 belongs to the unrelated lint_handoffs/GH-796 issue), and no dedicated ISS had been registered for GH-797.
investigation_notes: Verified on 2026-08-16: (1) PRM-02/03/04/05 are status: RELEASED in docs/requirements.yaml and docs/status/requirement_status.yaml (released_at 2026-08-15T23:28:26Z..23:28:29Z), delivered by WF02-prm02-05-20260816 via PR #795 (squash-merge 2e9d3c99, bookkeeping ae9854f4); (2) grep over docs/issues/ found no existing ISS referencing GH-797 / prm-reqctl / reqctl-status-stale — GH-797 had NO dedicated ISS; (3) docs/issues/ISS-0709.json is the lint_handoffs 42-findings issue (GH-796), unrelated to GH-797; (4) registry next_issue_id is 710, docs/issues/ISS-0710.json does not exist, and `gh issue list --search 'ISS-0710' --state all` returns no matches — no local/GitHub collision; (5) GH-797 is OPEN with labels duplicate, process, claimed-by-r-co-2-loop. Step 0.5 registers ISS-0710 and reconciles the GH-797 body reference; Step 3 implements the process-gap disposition.
reproduction: Not a runtime defect — no code reproduction required. The duplicate-run scenario: dispatch ADHOC-prm-reqctl-status-20260816 against a repo view predating PR #795; the pre-flight precondition aborts with BLOCKER ('if already RELEASED, STOP and FAIL with BLOCKER (someone else fixed it)').
notes: PROCESS-GAP RECOMMENDATION (for Step 1/2 consideration): an ADHOC dispatched against an outdated view of the repo can target work that has already been completed. A lightweight check (reqctl.py show <id>, or git show HEAD:<file> for the affected requirement IDs) at dispatch time would have short-circuited this run before step-00 created the housekeeping branch. Step 3 should decide and implement this guard. This Step 0.5 only registers the issue and reconciles GH-797; it does NOT implement the fix.
